name: Task Manager
tagline: Organize tasks, track progress, and plan your day
description:
Task Manager — Organize Your Work and Plan Your Day

Task Manager is a productivity app that helps individuals organize tasks, track progress, and plan daily work through a simple interface connected to an authenticated Django REST API.

KEY FEATURES
- Create tasks with a title, description, and priority.
- Retrieve and review existing tasks.
- Request task summaries and review overdue work.
- Generate a daily plan to organize your workload.
- Connect to backend task-management tools through an MCP-compatible integration.

HOW TO USE
1. Configure the connected Django API and provide a valid DJANGO_API_TOKEN credential.
2. Open Task Manager in Anna.
3. Enter a task title, an optional description, and a priority.
4. Select Create Task to submit your task.
5. Select List My Tasks to retrieve your tasks.
6. Select Task Summary to review task information.
7. Select Daily Plan to generate your daily plan.

TECHNOLOGY
Python, Django REST Framework, Model Context Protocol (MCP), PostgreSQL, Redis, and Docker.

REQUIREMENTS
Task operations require a reachable backend API and valid authentication. Results depend on the connected API, permissions, and configured services.
